title: Credit Administration Entry Conditions for the Auto Loans Product Line
content:
An application is taken on a product of the Auto Loans line only where the applicant, the amount financed and the vehicle all sit inside that product's row of the table below. Each figure is an inclusive boundary: a value exactly equal to the stated limit satisfies the condition.

## Entry conditions by product

| Product | Youngest age at application, in whole years | Loans of this product in applied, active or delinquent status one customer may hold | Smallest amount financed, USD | Largest amount financed, USD | Largest amount financed as a percent of vehicle value | Oldest vehicle, in years | Highest odometer reading at application, miles | Eligible powertrains | Credit grades underwriting may approve |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Used Vehicle Loan | 18 | 2 | 5000.00 | 75000.00 | 110 | 10 | 125000 | any | A, B, C, D |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan | 18 | 2 | 7500.00 | 90000.00 | 120 | 6 | 75000 | any | A, B, C |
| Auto Refinance Loan | 18 | 2 | 7500.00 | 90000.00 | 110 | 10 | 125000 | any | A, B, C |
| Lease Buyout Loan | 18 | 1 | 10000.00 | 90000.00 | 110 | 5 | 75000 | any | A, B, C |
| New Vehicle Loan | 18 | 2 | 7500.00 | 125000.00 | 125 | 1 | 5000 | any | A, B, C, D |
| Green Vehicle Loan | 18 | 2 | 7500.00 | 125000.00 | 125 | 1 | 5000 | battery electric, plug-in hybrid, hybrid | A, B, C, D |

## How three of the columns are read

Vehicle value, for the purposes of the percentage column, is the lower of the purchase price and the book value. Vehicle age in years is the current calendar year less the model year. The odometer column is the reading taken at application.

## Conditions particular to four products

Beyond the table, the Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan is written only on a manufacturer-certified vehicle. The Auto Refinance Loan is written only where a lien on the vehicle is already held by another lender. The Lease Buyout Loan is written only where the applicant is the lessee named on the lease. The Green Vehicle Loan is written only where the vehicle's powertrain is one of the three listed against it.

## Applications that sit just inside and just outside a row

An applicant whose eighteenth birthday falls on the application date meets the age column, since the column is the youngest age accepted. A vehicle showing exactly 125000 miles is inside the Used Vehicle Loan row and outside the Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan row. A request to finance exactly 90000.00 USD is inside the Auto Refinance Loan row; a request to finance 90000.01 USD is not. A customer already holding one Lease Buyout Loan in active status cannot take a second, because that product's column reads 1, while the same customer may still be inside the row of another product.
